summary: The change from TextField to CharField(max_length=255) for User.note is deployed by applying the new version's Django migration, which alters the column type, followed by retiring the old version. No separate SQL stages are needed; the migration handles the schema change atomically.
write_consistency: After the new version's migration runs, the note column becomes varchar(255). Both versions will then write notes through this column; the old version's notes may be truncated to 255 characters, but the migration is assumed to handle existing data safely, ensuring all notes remain accessible.
